documents.finding: Win32 FileStandardInfo returns FILE_STANDARD_INFO, whose size is passed exactly; false returns propagate OS error. This declaration review does not prove every filesystem accepts the request.

Native FileStandardInformation can be queried on an open handle without a particular DesiredAccess requirement. Used as supporting access-rights evidence, not as a claim the candidate directly calls this kernel API.
Reopens the original CreateFile filesystem object with requested access/share/flags; FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS is supported for directories. Sharing conflicts and native access-denied remain errors.

DACL retrieval requires READ_CONTROL granted on open; returned DACL borrows the returned security descriptor, released using LocalFree. The API does not serialize concurrent security-descriptor changes.

Handle-based setter preserves object identity; inheritable entries can propagate and the API does not reorder existing ACEs. The candidate supplies original explicit masks and inheritance; no MAXIMUM_ALLOWED handle is used.
